thread:
marta: Heads up — CI for the ruby quickstart sampleapp started failing after the token-refresh example PR landed. Failing on the GH Actions ruby matrix when bundler hits native gems on ruby 2.6. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sampleapp/pull/1187
kevin: seen. what error are we getting? is it the old ffi native build thing?
marta: yeah short log: ```Building native extensions. Gem::Ext::BuildError: ERROR: Failed to build gem native extension. extconf.rb ... checking for rb_thread_blocking_region... no```
oliver: we dropped official support for 2.6 in the gemspec a while back, but the sampleapp still has `.ruby-version` pinned to 2.6 and the actions matrix includes 2.6. two quick options: update .ruby-version + matrix to 2.7+, or add a conditional to skip native builds on 2.6.
kevin: simplest is to stop testing 2.6 in CI for that sample app. i'll open a tiny fix PR to change the matrix to 2.7/2.8. can revert quick if anyone objects.
marta: agree — onboarding docs also mention 2.7 in a couple places, so keeping CI aligned is fine. Reminder to update the quickstart README if we remove 2.6.
kevin: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sampleapp/pull/1190 — changes `ruby-version` and GH Actions matrix to `[2.7,2.8]`. also pinned bundler to 2.2 in the actions step to reduce build flakes.
ci-bot: Workflow run started for PR #1190 — ubuntu-latest / ruby-2.7, ruby-2.8
marta: tiny nit: can you also add a comment in the gemfile explaining why we pin bundler in CI? people keep removing it by accident.
kevin: added a one-line comment in the PR description and updated the file.
oliver: :thumbsup: lgtm. very small change.
marta: thanks! once CI passes i'll merge and backport a doc note to the onboarding guide. leaving a TODO in the repo issues (#569).
ci-bot: All checks passed for PR #1190
marta: merging now. :rocket:
kevin: cheers — will follow up with a quick changelog entry and ping support channels to avoid confusion for new users.
